Breakfast

Nutella-Stuffed Protein French Toast

Golden, custardy French-toast sandwiches hide a chocolate-hazelnut protein filling. The full recipe makes two generous servings.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
20 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
12

Ingredients

  • 2 large eggs
  • ½ cup (120 ml) unsweetened almond milk, divided
  • 1 scoop (30 g) vanilla whey protein
  • 1 tbsp zero-calorie sweetener, divided
  • 1 scoop (30 g) chocolate whey protein
  • 1 tbsp (20 g) Nutella
  • 1 tbsp (8 g) powdered peanut butter
  • 1 tbsp (5 g) cocoa powder
  • ¼ tsp hazelnut extract
  • 3 tbsp (45 ml) almond milk, as needed, approximate amount
  • 4 thick slices bread, ideally brioche
  • Cooking spray

Amounts are scaled from 2 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Whisk eggs, ½ cup almond milk, vanilla whey and half the sweetener in a shallow dish.
  2. In a bowl, mix chocolate whey, Nutella, powdered peanut butter, cocoa, remaining sweetener and hazelnut extract. Add the extra almond milk a tablespoon at a time until thick and spreadable.
  3. Trim the crusts if you like. Spread the filling over two bread slices, top with the other slices and cut each sandwich in half.
  4. Warm a lightly greased skillet over medium heat. Dip each sandwich in the egg mixture, turning to coat, then cook 3–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
  5. If the centers are still soft, stand the halves on their cut edges and cook briefly. Serve warm.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
